s: What are you going to do, George?|乔治，你打算做什么？
I'm going to make a bookcase.|我打算做一个书架。
What are you doing now? I'm painting it.|你现在在做什么？我在给它刷漆。

t: What are you going to do?
g: be going to 与现在进行
s: What are you going to do this evening?|你今晚打算做什么？
I'm going to write a letter.|我打算写一封信。
What are you doing now? I'm reading.|你现在在做什么？我在读书。
What are you going to do with that vase?|你打算怎么处理那个花瓶？
I'm going to put it on this table.|我打算把它放在这张桌子上。
Don't drop it! Be careful.|别摔了！小心点。

t: What are you going to do? I'm going to...
s: What are you going to do? I'm going to wash the dishes.|你打算做什么？我打算洗碗。
What are you going to do? I'm going to sweep the floor.|你打算做什么？我打算扫地。
What are you going to do? I'm going to clean the windows.|你打算做什么？我打算擦窗户。
Is there a bag on the table?|桌子上有个包吗？
Yes, there is. It's Penny's bag.|是的。是彭妮的包。
Is there any money in it? No, there isn't.|里面有现金吗？没有。
Is there a book on the desk? Yes, there is.|书桌上有书吗？有的。
Is there a cat under the chair? No, there isn't.|椅子下面有猫吗？没有。
Is there any milk in the bottle? Yes, there is.|瓶子里有牛奶吗？有的。
Hurry up! The bus is coming.|快点！公交车来了。
Are there any buses in the street?|街上有公交车吗？
No, there aren't. We must walk.|没有。我们必须走路。
Are there any apples in the box? Yes, there are.|箱子里有苹果吗？有的。
Are there any eggs in the fridge? No, there aren't.|冰箱里有鸡蛋吗？没有。
Is there any tea in the cup? Yes, there is.|杯里有茶吗？有的。
Can you type this letter for me, Pamela?|帕梅拉，你能帮我打这封信吗？
I'm sorry, I can't. The boss is waiting.|对不起，我不能。老板在等。
Can you come here a minute, please?|你能过来一下吗？
Can you swim? Yes, I can.|你会游泳吗？会。
Can you speak English? Yes, I can, a little.|你会说英语吗？会一点。
Can you help me? Sorry, I can't.|你能帮我吗？对不起，不能。

g: Do you like...? Do you want...?
s: Do you like coffee, Ann?|安，你喜欢咖啡吗？
Yes, I do. I like black coffee.|是的，我喜欢。我喜欢黑咖啡。
Do you want a cup of coffee? Yes, please.|你想要一杯咖啡吗？好的。
Do you like apples? Yes, I do.|你喜欢苹果吗？喜欢。
Do you want an orange? No, thank you.|你想要个橘子吗？不用了，谢谢。
Do you like biscuits? No, I don't.|你喜欢饼干吗？不喜欢。

g: He likes... but he doesn't like...
s: Do you want any meat today, Mrs. Bird?|伯德太太，今天要买点肉吗？
Yes, please. A pound of steak.|好的，请来一磅牛排。
He likes steak, but he doesn't like chicken.|他喜欢牛排，但不喜欢鸡肉。

t: He likes... But he doesn't like...
s: He likes meat, but he doesn't like fish.|他喜欢肉，但不喜欢鱼。
She likes apples, but she doesn't like oranges.|她喜欢苹果，但不喜欢橘子。
They like tea, but they don't like coffee.|他们喜欢茶，但不喜欢咖啡。
Where do you come from? I come from Greece.|你从哪里来？我来自希腊。
What's the climate like in your country?|你们国家的气候怎么样？
It's very pleasant. It's always warm.|非常宜人。总是很温暖。
What nationality are they? They're English.|他们是哪国人？英国人。
Where do they come from? They come from England.|他们从哪里来？来自英国。
What's the climate like in England? It's mild.|英国的气候怎么样？很温和。
I'm from England. The climate here is interesting.|我来自英国。这里的气候很有意思。
What's the weather like in spring? It's often windy.|春天的天气怎么样？常常刮风。
Which season do you like best? I like summer.|你最喜欢哪个季节？我喜欢夏天。
What nationality is she? She's French.|她是哪国人？法国人。
Where does she come from? She comes from France.|她从哪里来？来自法国。
What nationality are you? I'm Chinese.|你是哪国人？我是中国人。
The Sawyers live at 87 King Street.|索耶一家住在国王街87号。
In the morning, Mr. Sawyer goes to work.|早上，索耶先生去上班。
The children go to school in the morning.|孩子们早上去上学。
What does he usually do in the evening?|他晚上通常做什么？
He usually reads a newspaper.|他通常看报纸。
What do they usually do on Sunday? They stay at home.|他们周日通常做什么？待在家里。

g: 现在进行与一般现在对比
s: It's eight o'clock. Mr. Sawyer is having breakfast.|八点了。索耶先生正在吃早饭。
It's ten o'clock. The children are playing in the park.|十点了。孩子们正在公园里玩。
Today is an unusual day. Everyone is late.|今天是不寻常的一天。大家都迟到了。
What's the time? It's six o'clock.|几点了？六点。
What's the time? It's half past seven.|几点了？七点半。
What's the time? It's a quarter past nine.|几点了？九点一刻。
Is that all? Yes, that's all.|就这些吗？是的，就这些。
What's the time? It's five o'clock.|几点了？五点。
I must go home now. It's late.|我现在必须回家了。很晚了。
What's the time? It's twenty past eight.|几点了？八点二十。
What's the time? It's twenty-five to ten.|几点了？九点三十五。
What's the time? It's half past eleven.|几点了？十一点半。
What's the matter with him? He has a bad cold.|他怎么了？他得了重感冒。
He must stay in bed for two days.|他必须卧床两天。
He must take some medicine, too.|他还必须吃点药。
What's the matter with her? She has a headache.|她怎么了？她头痛。
What must she do? She must take an aspirin.|她该怎么办？她必须吃一片阿司匹林。
What's the matter with the children? They have a cough.|孩子们怎么了？他们咳嗽。
How's Jimmy today? He's better, thank you.|吉米今天怎么样？好多了，谢谢。
You mustn't smoke, Jimmy. You must keep warm.|吉米，你不能抽烟。你必须保暖。
Thank you, doctor. I'll follow your advice.|谢谢医生。我会听您的建议。
Don't eat too much. You mustn't eat sweets.|别吃太多。你不能吃糖。
Don't stay up late. You must go to bed early.|别熬夜。你必须早睡。
Don't be late again. You mustn't forget your book.|别再迟到。你不能忘记带书。
What's the time? It's half past eight.|几点了？八点半。
You must go to bed, Jimmy. I'm not a baby.|你该睡觉了，吉米。我不是小孩子了。
Do your homework first, then you can watch TV.|先做作业，然后才能看电视。
What's the time? It's a quarter to seven.|几点了？六点三刻。
It's time to get up. It's time for school.|该起床了。该上学了。
What's the time? It's ten to nine. Hurry up!|几点了？九点差十分。快点！
What are you going to do this weekend?|这个周末你打算做什么？
We're going to stay at home on Saturday.|我们周六打算待在家里。
On Sunday we're going to visit our friends.|周日我们打算去看朋友。
What's the time? It's twenty past four.|几点了？四点二十。
What time does the film begin? At six o'clock.|电影几点开始？六点。
What time do you have lunch? At half past twelve.|你几点吃午饭？十二点半。
There is a car race near our town every year.|我们镇附近每年都有一场汽车赛。
In 1995, there was a very big race.|1995年有一场很大的比赛。
When were they there? They were there last year.|他们什么时候在那里的？去年。

zh: 他们什么时候在那里的？
s: When were you there? I was there in 1998.|你什么时候在那里的？1998年。
When was he in Japan? He was there last month.|他什么时候在日本？上个月。
When were they at school? They were there yesterday.|他们什么时候在学校？昨天。
When did you see him? I saw him last night.|你什么时候见到他的？昨晚。
He's awful! He never says hello.|他讨厌透了！他从不打招呼。
When did she come? She came at nine o'clock.|她什么时候来的？九点。
When did you go to London? I went last week.|你什么时候去伦敦的？上周。
When did you meet her? I met her in May.|你什么时候遇见她的？五月。
When did they arrive? They arrived at six.|他们什么时候到的？六点。
